prompt: A cute, flat-style vector illustration of a capybara soaking in a yuzu hot spring. The capybara has a deadpan, relaxed expression with half-closed eyes and is holding a single yellow yuzu fruit in its mouth. A stack of three wobbling yuzu fruits rests on top of its head. The hot spring is filled with pale yellow water and surrounded by smooth grey stones. To the left, there is a small white drawstring pouch containing a yuzu. Wisps of steam rise from the water. The entire scene is rendered as a sticker with a thick white outline against a solid mint green background.

promptZh: 一幅可爱的扁平风格矢量插画，描绘了一只正在泡柚子温泉的水豚。水豚双眼半闭，神情呆萌又放松，嘴里叼着一颗黄色的柚子。它头顶上叠放着三颗摇摇晃晃的柚子。温泉水呈淡黄色，四周环绕着光滑的灰色石头。左侧有一个白色小束口袋，里面装着一颗柚子。水面上飘起缕缕热气。整个画面被设计成一枚贴纸，带有粗白描边，背景为纯薄荷绿色。
